# S0015 p2-4 — secret-leak fingerprint corpus (E2E-9).
#
# The scanner (fixtures/e2e/e2e-t2-secrets.sh) does NOT use naive keyword regex
# ("PRIVATE KEY", "signing key"). It derives fingerprints from ACTUAL key material in
# MULTIPLE FORMS and greps the run's corpus (control+bp1 audit DBs + /var/log +
# cardano-node.log + the dispatch JSON transcript + a set -x trace) for any of them.
#
# Live secrets (KES/VRF/cold skey, genesis-delegate keys) are regenerated FRESH per
# devnet boot, so their concrete fingerprints are computed AT TEST TIME from the running
# node in these forms: raw cborHex, sha256(file), sha256(cborHex). (The filename/path is
# NOT fingerprinted — it is public config that node startup legitimately references.)
#
# This file holds the STABLE, committed CANARY — a throwaway non-secret used only to prove
# the scanner actually detects a leak. If, after injecting the canary into the corpus, its
# fingerprint is NOT found, the scan is a no-op and E2E-9 FAILS (the "canary must fail" leg).
canary-plaintext: OURO-CANARY-SECRET-DO-NOT-LEAK-v1
canary-sha256: f6d514d67b4a77eb2c39387d45d1ffe78fb38cf12c49255d3a570c6eec5f4c29
